verdict.rationale: Codegen documents an official CLI with a dedicated docs page. The CLI lets you view and create agents, pull agent work into your local environment, manage organizations and repositories, and launch an interactive TUI. It also wraps local Claude Code with telemetry and injects MCP access to your Codegen integrations. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI beyond vendor docs and a probe confirming the docs page exists.
